text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The year-end Arima Kinen is here. Yaeno Muteki is running as well, having been voted in second by the fans, just behind Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: It's no surprise Yaeno Muteki got second in the vote! She's gone toe-to-toe against the Eternal Top Three time and time again. And she's cool to boot! Glad she's getting her dues!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: I saw her at one of Ogurin's races, and she got me hook, line, and sinker! I'm a fan through and through now!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Speaking of Oguri Cap, doesn't she seem a bit off lately? I wonder if something happened to her…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap certainly hasn't been racing like normal these days.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oguriiiiin! You can do it! Gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh… Ogurin didn't seem to have her usual edge today…

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Do you think she's sick? Maybe she's not eating well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I don't know what happened either… I wonder what's wrong…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: She should rest if she's not feeling well. I'd… well, I'd rather not watch her race if she's in pain, you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Oguri Cap still won the popularity poll for the Arima Kinen. Clearly, many of her fans still expect a lot from her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure Yaeno Muteki also wants to run against Oguri Cap, who has been dubbed the Beast.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It may not be the main event, but that's no excuse to look sloppy. We have to put our best foot forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, all of the Arima Kinen competitors are attending a greeting session as a way of interacting with the fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone will head out onto the turf and give a brief but heartfelt introduction.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hello, Oguri. Good luck today!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Oh, right… You too…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oguri had her head hung the whole time.
choice_data_list: It might be because she's been in a slump.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But if she keeps this up…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: This year's Arima Kinen entrants have taken to the turf!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki! I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Don't hold back, Yaeno Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan B
text_block_list.text: Run like your old self, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oguriiin! You got this! I believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Next up is our runner-up in the popularity poll and the winner of the autumn Tenno Sho… Yaeno Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Nice, Yaeno Muteki! You look ready to go already!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And now, thanks to the support of her many, many fans—introducing the winner of the fan vote… Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah! Oguriiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan B
text_block_list.text: O-GU-RI! O-GU-RI!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Aaah… AAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HRRRYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: What's this?! Yaeno Muteki has suddenly taken off at full speed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter, chatter!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She's run all the way to the fourth corner! Oh! She's turning around! She's coming back!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Y-Yaeno?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Finally… You've finally picked up your head.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You take the support of the public and turn it into power!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's your strength!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If you hang your head and close yourself off to those around you, you won't be able to use that strength!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How do you intend to beat me like that?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Me! Yaeno Muteki! At the height of my power!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Don't close yourself off! Listen to all the voices crying out for you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Turn that support into power and run!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's all I want to say.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oguriiiin! Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan B
text_block_list.text: You can win, Oguri! I know you can!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Everyone…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I can hear your voices. I can feel your support and warmth, filling up the void inside of me…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And I will answer you all, just watch and see!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap looks up toward the stands and waves vigorously at her supporters.
